name: Floating sidebar
description: App navigation in a floating panel with a team switcher, quick search, a sliding current-page highlight and an icon-only mode.

props.name: teams
props.type: { id: string; name: string; plan?: string; logo?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Teams in the switcher at the top. A team without a logo shows its initials.

props.name: team
props.description: Id of the chosen team (controlled). Use defaultTeam when uncontrolled; the first team is chosen otherwise.

props.name: onTeamChange
props.description: Called when another team is picked from the menu.

props.name: onCreateTeam
props.description: Called by "Create team" at the foot of the team menu.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; icon: ReactNode; count?: number; countTone?: "neutral" | "solid"; href?: string }[]
props.description: The main navigation. A solid count is a water pill, and stays on the icon when collapsed. With href an item renders as a link.

props.name: groups
props.description: Further labelled groups under the main items.

props.name: footerItems
props.description: Items pinned to the bottom, above the user row.

props.name: user
props.type: { name: string; email: string; avatar?: string }
props.description: The signed-in person, shown at the bottom with an account menu.

props.name: onUserAction
props.description: Called with "profile", "preferences", "shortcuts" or "sign-out" from the account menu.

props.name: current
props.description: Id of the current item (controlled). The highlight slides to it. Use defaultCurrent when uncontrolled.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called when an item is pressed.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Icons-only mode, 64 pixels wide (controlled). Use defaultCollapsed when uncontrolled. Labels then show in tooltips.

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Called by the round button on the panel's edge, and by ⌘K while collapsed, which opens the panel and focuses search.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Shows the round button on the panel's edge that collapses and expands it. Set false where the panel should keep its width, such as in a drawer.

props.name: action
props.description: A slot between quick search and the navigation, for a main action such as "New chat". Pass a function to render something narrower, such as an icon button, while the panel is collapsed.

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Called when Enter is pressed in the quick search field.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the panel. It fills the height of its container. Also accepts every other aside attribute. To show it in a Drawer on small screens, render it inside the drawer with collapsible={false}, collapsed={false} and className="min-h-0 flex-1", and give the drawer closeButton={false} and a transparent, borderless panel 264px wide (see the drawer demo).
